title: Ye karbobala hai wawaila
body:
zehra ki sada hai wawaila
<<MINI>>
ye karbobala hai wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
taraaj huwa farwa ka chaman
jo maara gaya hai ibne hasan
pamaal huwa qasim dulha
<<MINI>>
ye karbobala hai wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
akber ke jigar me barchhi hai
laila jo pisar ko roti hai
dekha nahi jaata hai rona
<<MINI>>
ye karbobala hai wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas pade hai'n dariya par aur bhai ko rote hai'n sarwar
karti hai sakina ab girya
<<MINI>>
ye karbobala hai wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir jo rukhsat hote hai'n
masoom lipat kar rote hain
kehte hai na jao aye moula
<<MINI>>
ye karbobala hai wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai sakina ab rokar
mai soti rahi hoo'n seene par
soungi mai kaise aye baba
<<MINI>>
ye karbobala hai wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ka kaleja phat-ta hai
bete ka gala jo kat-ta hai
pyaase pa jafa hai wawaila
<<MINI>>
ye karbobala hai wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
dil thaam ke rote hain sarwar
bejaan huwa hai jo asghar
pyaasa hi raha dil sarwar ka
<<MINI>>
ye karbobala hai wawaila
